# Twinstar: Mirror Comets

> A free one-touch arcade game for Android and iOS. Two mirrored comets are steered
> with a single input through asymmetric gates. No account, no in-app purchases.

Bundle id: com.twinstar.app · Rated 4+ · Free, ad-supported

## What an agent can get here

- [Privacy policy (human)](https://rafmoshe2500.github.io/twinstar-privacy/privacy.html): the full policy.
- [Privacy policy (machine)](https://rafmoshe2500.github.io/twinstar-privacy/privacy.json): the same
  policy as structured JSON — data types, processors, purposes, identity linkage, tracking flags,
  opt-out routes, retention and contact. This is the canonical source; the HTML is generated from
  the same facts.
- [Game overview](https://rafmoshe2500.github.io/twinstar-privacy/): features, modes and screenshots.

The privacy page also registers WebMCP tools when the browsing agent supports
`navigator.modelContext`, so the policy can be queried directly instead of scraped.
Tools: `get_privacy_summary`, `list_data_collected`, `list_third_party_services`,
`get_opt_out_instructions`, `get_contact_and_deletion`.

## Key facts

- We operate no game servers that store personal data. The core game runs fully offline.
- All personal-data processing is done by named third parties: Google AdMob (ads),
  Google Play Games (Android leaderboards + cloud save), Apple Game Center (iOS leaderboards),
  Google Firebase (WebRTC handshake for online 1v1 only), and a TURN relay provider.
- Exactly one permission prompt exists: App Tracking Transparency on iOS, shown at the first run
  ending or first opt-in ad. Denying it does not reduce functionality.
- Not collected: names, emails, phone numbers, GPS location, photos, contacts, microphone, camera.
- Cloud save is Android-only in this version.
- Online 1v1 is peer-to-peer by 5-character room code. The "VS Computer" option is a local AI
  opponent and makes no network request.
